text: きしょうが　はげしく　しっぽを　まっすぐ　たてたら　よう　ちゅうい。

structure.jp: きしょうが　はげしく
しっぽを　まっすぐ　たてたら
structure.en: if it raises its tail straight up

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. たてたら = 'if it raises it'.

patterns.name: 〜く (linking)
patterns.span: きしょうが　はげしく
patterns.explanation: Ending a describing word in く instead of い lets the sentence go on, like 'and' in writing. きしょうが　はげしく = 'its temper is fierce, and'.
